strings.privacy.title: Ũgitĩri
strings.privacy.description: Atĩa pdffusion irutithagia dosi ciaku: gũtirĩ akaunti, gũtirĩ dosi ĩgwo, gũtirĩ matangazo na gũtirĩ gũtunda ũhoro.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion nĩ yombirwo nĩguo dosi ciaku ciarĩ cia kũ. Haha nĩ mandiko ma hinya, kĩrĩa gĩkĩhĩtia rĩrĩa wĩra ũrutithagio.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosi ciaku
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Nĩ citumagwo ciarĩgitĩritwo (HTTPS), igĩthondekwo kwa wĩra, thutha ciagwo mara imwe kĩrĩa kĩthondeketwo kĩtegithĩte. Dosi nene cirotithagio hakuhi na rĩĩtwa rĩa kĩha na nĩ cigatagirwo wĩra ũrio ũrĩkia; kũtheria kwa wĩra nĩ kũthara kĩndũ gĩothe gĩtiga thĩinĩ wa thaa 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Gũtirĩ akaunti, gũtirĩ ũhoro waku
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion ndĩendaga kwandĩkithia, gũtirĩ anuuni ya thirĩ na gũtirĩ karata ya kĩbega. Dosi ciaku ndĩthomeragwo, ndĩthereragwo, ndĩgayanagwo kana nĩ ciumagwo kũrutithia arũme a ũũgĩ.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kũringwo kwanja
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tũringaga matandiko tũtarĩ na marĩĩtwa na gũtirĩ kũgira cookies (Vercel Web Analytics) nĩguo twĩmanyĩre indo iria irutithagia wĩra. Gũtirĩ matangazo, gũtirĩ gũteng'eria mĩthia.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie ĩmwe ya kũhitia: ĩriragĩria rũrimi rĩa wũrĩirie.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kũrirwo
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Ithandiko nĩ rĩriragwo nĩ Vercel seva-inĩ cia Paris; Word, Excel na PowerPoint nĩ ciarutithagio wĩra nĩ Render seva-inĩ cia Frankfurt. Aheani aya marutithagia dosi wĩra tu wa kahinda ka gũgarura.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Twĩteithie
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ũria kana macokio? Twĩkinyĩre kuuma ithandiko-inĩ rĩa wĩra:
strings.legal.terms.title: Watho wa kũhũthĩra
strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion nĩ ya tawa kũrĩ o wothe, hamwe na biashara na thirikari. Dosii ciaku ni ciaku: gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩthometheka kana kĩigĩtwo.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Watho ũyu nĩwo ũtongoragia kũhũthĩra gwaku kwa pdffusion. Nĩ mĩhuhũru ya kũigana na kĩandĩkwo kĩoru. Na kũhũthĩra kĩndũ gĩkĩ, wĩtĩkĩra.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ũrĩa ũpasagia pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdffusion nĩĩthondekete, yakĩtwo na ĩgathondekwo nĩ Mikailou Cedric Toure, mwandĩki wa thĩini wa New Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Rũtusa rwa kũhũthĩra kwa tawa, kũrĩ o wothe
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion nĩ ya tawa, itari na kũiyũria fomu na itari na hinda ya gũkera, kũrĩ o wothe: andũ othe, arut uczni, arutithia, biashara, mĩbango itari ya biashara, thirikari cia kuuma na mabururi mangĩ, thĩini wa Canada na bururi wothe. Gũtirĩ kũhũthĩra gũtigĩtwo kũrĩ wathĩri wa mbeca, tondũ gũtirĩ. Dosii iria ũthondekete ni ciaku biũ: itirĩ na kĩndũ gĩkũhonokeithagia kana rĩtwa rĩa pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Dosii ciaku ciothe, o na iria cia hitho
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Ũhootagwo gũthondeka mũthemba wothe wa dosii, hamwe na iria cia hitho, tondũ pdffusion ndĩthometheka, ndĩthuthuria, ndĩiga kana ndĩheana dosii ciaku: nĩthondekete weterene na gũthangwo. Nĩwe mwene, na wĩ mwandĩki wa gũkorwo na mĩtugo ya kũthondeka.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Kĩhumo kĩa ndeto na kũhura thĩini wa macini ciaku
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Kĩhumo kĩa ndeto kĩa pdffusion kĩmenyithagio thĩini wa watho wa MIT. Ũhootagwo gũgithoma, kũgithuthuria, kũgĩhura thĩini wa macini ciaku (hamwe na cia mĩtambo ĩtarĩ na Intaneti), kũgĩthondeka na kũgĩabania kũtarĩ na mbeca, kũringana na wĩna kĩmenyithio kĩa wene na watho wa MIT.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Kũhũthĩra gũkwagirire
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ndũhootagwo gũhũthĩra pdffusion kũrua watho, kũgeria kũniina mĩtambo (gũtuma dosii nyingĩ mũno, gũtwara kũrĩa gũtarĩ gwaku) kana kũringĩra mĩmera ya tekinoroji. Igima cia mwingi wa dosii nĩ cigitĩire mĩtambo kũrĩ o wothe.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Kũoneka kwa mĩtambo
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdffusion nĩĩheanagwo yari ya tawa. Ĩhootagwo gũhinduka, kũnyitwo hinda ya gũthondeka kana kũrekio. Rora o na ũiga dosii ciaku cia mbere: pdffusion ndĩigaga gĩkũrwo kiayo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Ũgitĩri na wathĩri
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Mĩtambo ĩheanagwo “ũguo ĩrĩ”, ĩtarĩ na wathĩri wothe. Kũringana na watho, mwandĩki ndĩheyo ya thahu ya kũniina, gĩkũrwo kĩa ndeto kana kũthondeka gũtarĩ kwa kũringana. Rora dosii cia gũthondeka mbere ya kũhũthĩra kũrĩ kĩndũ kĩa bata.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Wene wa tekinoroji
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Rĩtwa rĩa pdffusion, gĩtindiko kĩayo na ndeto cia kĩndũ gĩkĩ nĩ cia mwandĩki; kĩhumo kĩrĩ thĩini wa watho wa MIT ta ũrĩa kuugwo igũrũ. Mathĩri ma mĩtambo maratawa (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) nĩ maeneo ma mwene wao.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Watho ũrĩa ũtongoragia
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Watho ũyu ũtongoragio na watho wa Gĩcigo kĩa New Brunswick na watho wa thirikari ya Canada. Maathi ma New Brunswick nĩmo mari wathĩri, itari na kũniina mawatho ma bururi waku ta mũhũthĩri.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Mathĩndo
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Watho ũyu ũhootagwo gũthondekwo. Tariki ya igũrũ ya mbica ĩyonania mũthemba ũrĩa wĩ watho; gũhinduka gũthũkagia o kũhũthĩra thutha wa kũmenyithio.
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].title: Kũmanyana
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Ũria riũria rĩa watho ũyu? Twandĩkĩre kuuma kũrĩa mĩtambo ĩrĩ:
strings.legal.security.title: Ũgitĩri na maũndũ ma ndeto
strings.legal.security.description: Kũrĩa gũgũthiaga dosii ciaku thĩini wa pdffusion: kũthondeka kwatereire, gũtirĩ kũthuthuria, gũthangwo mĩtũhĩ, kũgitĩra, kũigwo Yuropu, na kũhura thĩini wa macini ciaku.
strings.legal.security.intro: Kũrĩa gũgũthiaga dosii ciaku, kũrĩa gũthondekagwo na ũrĩa cigitĩtwo: kũringana na wĩna kĩoru, kũrĩ o wothe na mĩtambo.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Gũtirĩ dosii igigĩtwo
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Dosii ciaku nĩthondekete wetene, igaciuka gũthangwo o rĩrĩa kĩrĩkia gĩtwo kana kũniinwo. Gũtirĩ gĩkũrwo, gũtirĩ gĩthigirĩro na gũtirĩ gĩkũrwo kĩa tene. Kũthangwo kwa kĩgongona kwa hinda ciothe nĩ kũniinaga dosii cia hinda o hinda kũu kũrĩa gũkiri mbere.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Gũtirĩ kũthuthuria
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Gũtirĩ mundũ ũthometheka dosii ciaku. Itirĩ cigĩtwo, itirĩ thuthuri, itirĩ abanwo kana ci hũthĩrwo kũrutana akili ya kĩruki. pdffusion ndĩri mĩbango, ndĩri matangazo na ndĩri mĩthemba ya ahũthĩri.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ũgitĩri
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Wĩtikanio wothe nĩ wendekete (HTTPS) na kĩndũ kĩgitagĩra kũkinyĩra gĩkĩ kĩrĩo (HSTS). Mĩtambo ya kũgitĩra nĩ ĩgitĩragwo PDF ciaku na AES-256; kiama gĩa kũgitĩra gĩtiigagwo.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Kũrĩa dosii ciaku thondekeragwo
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Mĩtambo ya mbica na PDF: Vercel, kũndũ kũrĩa maũndũ marigĩtwo Paris (Fransi, Kĩũngano kĩa Yuropu). Kũthondeka Word, Excel na PowerPoint: Render, Frankfurt (Jamiini, Kĩũngano kĩa Yuropu). Dosii iria nene gũkira MB 4: kũndũ kũrĩa maũndũ marigĩtwo ha hinda gwa Vercel Blob, na rĩtwa rĩa kĩmenyero, gũthangwo thutha wa kũhũthĩra.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ũgitĩri wa tekinoroji
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Mathĩro ma ũgitĩri (HSTS, gũtiga kũrekeria mĩtambo thĩini wa mbica ingĩ, kũgitĩra kũrĩ kũhithia mĩthemba ya dosii), mĩtambo ya hinda hinda itahumbũkwo, na mĩtambo ya kũthondeka ĩtĩkĩragwo mĩrio ya kũtwara kĩama kĩa hitho. Gũhinduka kwerũ gwothe nĩ kworwo kĩrĩkia (magerio, kũrora mĩthemba) mbere ya gũkinyĩra kũrĩa kwega.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Wĩtĩkio na watho ũrĩa ũtongoragia
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion nĩĩthondekete New Brunswick na ĩrĩ na watho wa Canada wa Ũgitĩri wa Ndeto Cia Mwene na Mĩtambo ya Kũhũthĩra (PIPEDA). Ndĩriraga ndeto cia mwene cia ahũthĩri: gũtirĩ mĩbango, gũtirĩ mĩtambo ya barua, gũtirĩ kũrũrũmĩrĩra. Yakĩtwo na mĩtambo o ĩyo ya Kĩũngano kĩa Yuropu GDPR na Watho 25 wa Quebec: kũnyihia ndeto, gũtihũthĩra ringĩ, kũthangwo thutha wa kũthondeka.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kũrĩ mĩbango ĩrĩ na mawatho maremu
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Angĩkorwo mawatho manyo maretikĩria gũtuma dosii kũrĩ mĩtambo ya nja, hura pdffusion thĩini wa macini ciaku. Kĩndũ kĩothe kĩa mĩtambo nĩ kĩa tawa, gĩcokerio na kĩronania gĩtarĩ na Intaneti: gũtirĩ dosii ĩthiaga nja ya kĩũngano kĩa macini ciaku. Mũtambo wa kũhura ũrĩ kũrĩa mĩtambo ĩrĩ.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Kũoneka kweru
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Kĩhumo kĩa ndeto kĩrĩ kweru: atumwa a ũgitĩri nĩmoohootagwo kũrora kĩndũ gĩkĩ kĩothe.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Menyithia hinya wa mĩtambo
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Ũrĩ na wĩtĩkio wa kũona hinya wa Ũgitĩri? Menyithia na hitho kuuma gĩcigo kĩa “Ũgitĩri” kĩa mĩtambo:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Ũiganĩri wa ũtabarĩrio
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Kĩmenyithio kĩa ũiganĩri kĩa pdffusion: Watho wa WCAG 2.2 kiugo AA, mĩtambo ya kũgiriria, hinya wa kũmenyeka na ũrĩa ũngĩmenyithia hinya.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: O wothe nĩ kũgiriire gũhũthĩra pdffusion, hamwe na andũ atumwo mĩtũhĩ kana matheru, atumwo matarĩ na kiugo kana atumwo marĩ na hinya wa gwaka kana kũringania.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Mũthemba ũrĩa ũcookete
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion nĩĩririkaga kũringana na Mawatho ma Ũiganĩri wa Mĩtambo ya Intaneti (WCAG) 2.2, kiugo AA, watho wa W3C wa thĩ yothe. Kiugo gĩkĩ nĩ kĩmenyithagia mawatho ma Thirikari ya Canada, watho wa Yuropu EN 301 549 na Gĩcigo 508 kĩa United States, iria ciũragia WCAG 2.0 kana 2.1 kiugo AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Ũrĩa kũringaine
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion nĩĩringaine gatagati na WCAG 2.2 kiugo AA: hinya wa kũmenyeka nĩwandĩkithĩtwo thĩ ni. Kĩmenyithio gĩkĩ kĩrĩ kũringana na kũrora kwa thĩini kwarĩ kũrutwo Tariki 2 ya Mweri wa Ikũmi, 2026, tũhũthĩra mĩtambo ya mautini (axe, Lighthouse) na kũrora kwa guoko (kiama, kĩnyurani, kũneneha, kũmenyithia). Gũtirĩ kũrora gwa nja kũrutwo nja.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Kĩrĩa gĩkĩ kĩrĩho
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Mĩtambo yothe nĩĩrutagira wĩra na kiama, na kĩugo “Ĩtũka harĩa ũndũ ũrĩ” na gĩthiku kĩoneka kũrĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ wĩra. Kĩnyurani kĩa kiugo nĩ kĩa 4.5:1.
